incident-bot: INCIDENT: High 5xx rate (502/504) detected in apigw-eu-west-1 — paging on-call @sara. Alert: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/alerts/12345
sara: Acknowledged. Joining now, will grab metrics & logs.
oz: seeing a sharp spike at ~12:03 UTC. 502s jump to ~18% (baseline 0.4%). p99 latency up from 120ms -> 1.4s. grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc/apigw
sara: running quick checks: `kubectl -n gateway get pods -l app=apigw -o wide` — multiple apigw pods in eu-west show restarts and high CPU.
jen: any errors in proxy logs? `kubectl logs -n gateway apigw-7f5 -c proxy | tail -n 100`
kevin: support-bot shows a cluster of 502s originating from upstream timeouts to model-serving pool; queue depth on the edge muxer jumped.
dmitri: customer impact? which customers affected?
support-bot: Automated ticketing: 12 affected customers reporting elevated error rates (mostly timeouts) — top impacted: finco-app, chatflow, docs-search. ETA for customer notices: 15m if we confirm mitigation.
sara: looks like upstream model backends are healthy but connection churns causing upstream 502s. `ss -tanp | grep apigw` shows a lot of TIME_WAIT. Possible connection exhaustion on the edge muxer.
oz: quick mitigations: 1) enable circuit-breaker on heavy routes 2) throttle bursty clients 3) shift a portion of traffic to eu-west-2 warm pool 4) increase apigw replicas.
jen: preparing circuit-breaker patch for /v1/generate route, reducing max_pending to 2000 and enabling fast-fail.
jen: config snippet:
```
route: /v1/generate
circuit_breaker:
  max_connections: 500
  max_pending_requests: 2000
  fail_open: false
```
kevin: scaling apigw deployment in eu-west-1 from 6 -> 12:
`kubectl scale deployment apigw -n gateway --replicas=12`
kevin: applying now.
sara: applying a 10% traffic shift to eu-west-2 warm pool (canary). `trafficctl shift --from eu-west-1 --to eu-west-2 --pct 10 --routes '/v1/*'`
dmitri: can we also temporarily disable keepalive pooling to reduce connection reuse issues while we stabilize?
sara: doing it for the edge-proxy; toggling to short-lived connections.
support-bot: Notifying on-call support: draft message queued for affected customers. Jen to review.
jen: Draft to customers: "We're seeing elevated errors for inference endpoints in EU. Mitigation is underway; we'll update in 30m. No data loss."
oz: after scaling + circuit-breaker + 10% shift: 502 rate dropped from 18% -> 5% in last 2m. p99 latency down to ~300ms.
sara: logs show fewer upstream reset errors. Keeping watch on queue depth and pod restarts.
kevin: replicas are up. CPU back to normal on new pods.
dmitri: good. I'll monitor for side effects and watch eu-west-2 for capacity.
support-bot: Incident priority still P1. Auto-escalation window extended while we monitor.
sara: 502 rate now ~3.2% and trending down. I'll stay on until stable for 30m then hand off to daytime on-call.
oz: thumbs up :thumbsup: 
jen: posting interim customer note now.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation in progress — circuit-breaker + scale + 10% traffic shift. Monitoring for 30m before closure.
sara: follow-up action items: 1) run root-cause analysis on connection churn 2) evaluate muxer connection pools & TCP tuning 3) add synthetic checks for upstream connection resets.
kevin: will open infra ticket for autoscaling policy review.
dmitri: adding a runbook step to prefer warm pool pre-warming for bursts.
support-bot: logging incident and creating postmortem placeholder.
incident-bot: Incident moving to 'monitoring' status. If metrics remain steady for 30m, we'll resolve. Last update in 15m.
